svg.title: Harbor Goods catalog API on Amazon EKS: Terraform, Argo CD and autoscaling
svg.desc: Terraform builds the VPC, EKS cluster, IAM roles and alarms and installs Argo CD. Argo CD pulls the prod folder from GitHub and syncs in waves: controllers, then the Karpenter NodePool, then the catalog API chart. The HPA adds pods, Karpenter launches a node for them, and HTTPS requests flow through the ALB to the pods while Container Insights and alarms go to CloudWatch and SNS.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS CATALOG API · AMAZON EKS
